findings.evidence: TransportMatrix.lean:157-160 states the convention: `cost_def` exists because "The body of the definition is not exposed, so this is the lemma downstream modules should rewrite with"; `lakefile.toml` sets no expose option, and TwoByTwo.lean:22 is `public section` without `@[expose]`.
findings.fix: Add `twoByTwoLower_def : twoByTwoLower μ ν = max 0 ((μ 0).toReal + (ν 0).toReal - 1) := (rfl)`, `twoByTwoUpper_def`, and `twoByTwoCrossDiff_def := (rfl)` (the last is the one `simp` needs to discharge the `if`).
findings.issue: `twoByTwoLower` (31), `twoByTwoUpper` (35) and `twoByTwoCrossDiff` (194) are public defs in a plain `public section` (line 22, no `@[expose]`), so their bodies are invisible downstream. A consumer cannot show `x ∈ TwoByTwoParameter μ ν` from `Set.mem_Icc`, nor evaluate the condition `0 ≤ twoByTwoCrossDiff c` that gates `optimalTwoByTwoParameter_val`, `optimalTwoByTwo_apply_zero_zero`, `optimalTwoByTwo_cost_eq`; the whole optimizer API is unusable outside this file.

findings.fix: Add `@[simp] ofTwoByTwoParameter_apply (x) (i j) : ofTwoByTwoParameter x i j = ENNReal.ofReal (!![x.1, (μ 0).toReal - x.1; (ν 0).toReal - x.1, 1 - (μ 0).toReal - (ν 0).toReal + x.1] i j)`, and mark `ofTwoByTwoParameter_toReal_apply` `@[simp]` so all four real entries reduce.
findings.issue: `@[simp] twoByTwoCouplingEquiv_symm_apply` rewrites a coupling's point mass to `ofTwoByTwoParameter x p.1 p.2 : ℝ≥0∞`, but no lemma evaluates `ofTwoByTwoParameter` at the `ℝ≥0∞` level (the body is unexposed); only the `toReal` forms exist, and of those the general one (`ofTwoByTwoParameter_toReal_apply`, line 120) is not `@[simp]` while its `(0,0)` special case (line 114) is, so simp knows one entry and not the other three.

findings.evidence: TwoByTwo.lean:42 `namespace TransportMatrix` opens before line 172-226, while the endpoints are declared at `TauCeti` level (lines 31, 35); TransportMatrix.lean:220 declares `transportMatrixEquiv` outside the `TransportMatrix` namespace.
findings.fix: Move `twoByTwoLower_le_upper`, `twoByTwoCrossDiff`, `optimalTwoByTwoParameter`, and `twoByTwoCouplingEquiv` (and its two lemmas) to the `TauCeti` namespace, keeping under `TransportMatrix` only what has a matrix as its subject.
findings.issue: Declarations that take no `TransportMatrix` argument are placed in the `TransportMatrix` namespace: `twoByTwoLower_le_upper` (212) is a fact about `TauCeti.twoByTwoLower`/`twoByTwoUpper` yet is named `TauCeti.TransportMatrix.twoByTwoLower_le_upper`; likewise `twoByTwoCrossDiff` (194, a function of the cost alone), `optimalTwoByTwoParameter` (218), and `twoByTwoCouplingEquiv` (172, about couplings). The existing analogue `transportMatrixEquiv` sits at `TauCeti` level.

summary: The three new public definitions `twoByTwoLower`, `twoByTwoUpper`, and `twoByTwoCrossDiff` have unexposed bodies and no `_def` lemma, so downstream modules cannot evaluate the interval endpoints or the sign test that every headline lemma's right-hand side mentions. `ofTwoByTwoParameter` also lacks an `ℝ≥0∞`-level entry lemma, leaving the `@[simp]` coupling lemma stuck.
